question: Should gateway restart provenance use this separate 512-row SQLite ledger with its current metadata fields, or be narrowed/aligned with the canonical audit ledger’s privacy, access, and retention contract before merge?
rationale: The code can enforce either design safely, but only maintainers can authorize the permanent operational-metadata boundary and decide whether a second audit store is intentional product architecture.

options.title: Align and narrow first
options.body: Define approved fields, pseudonymization, access, and retention against the canonical audit contract before merging the restart producer.

options.title: Accept specialized ledger
options.body: Approve the separate metadata-only 512-row table as an intentionally internal forensic store and document its sensitive metadata and access expectations.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the PR if durable restart attribution does not justify another persistent operational-data surface.

recommendation.title: Align and narrow first
recommendation.body: Define approved fields, pseudonymization, access, and retention against the canonical audit contract before merging the restart producer.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined restart-path and related audit-product history available in the reviewed evidence.
